name: n8n
summary: n8n workflow automation with Caddy and PostgreSQL. Optional domain with HTTPS.
getting_started: Open your server address and sign in with the email and password shown once. The login and the encryption key are also stored on the server in /root/.beltoft-app/credentials.json. Keep the encryption key safe: without it, the logins you save in n8n cannot be restored on another server. Change the password in n8n's settings. Add a domain for HTTPS before you connect real accounts; without a domain the address is not encrypted. Outgoing mail on port 25 is blocked on all servers; use an SMTP service on port 587 or 465. Times in n8n use UTC until you change the timezone in settings. Set up a backup plan before you build workflows. You keep n8n up to date yourself, and you use it under n8n's Sustainable Use License (your own business use, not resale): https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/LICENSE.md
